triggerReasons.message: A milestone ledger exists, so every ledger row needs checklist and verificationIntent coverage.
High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.
Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: G02 has an independent 15-required-row ledger inventory and evaluates exactly 15 required rows.
acceptanceBindings.note: Covers the required inventory and standalone G02 identity.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: G02 leaves exactly one missing required row visible as open, invalid, and missing_required_row.
acceptanceBindings.note: Covers the negative-control row visibility contract.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: G02 blocks full roadmap completion wording and avoids elevated rollout claims.
The baseline document says G01 and G02 are implemented while G03-G10 and the full 10x15 baseline remain future/incomplete.

note: B-e891 may enter DEV only after the accepted G02 intent ledger is fully bound to checklist items and verificationIntent refs. Completion is local to G02 and must not claim the full 10x15 baseline.
